text: I want a short exercise plan for practicing a new piano piece. The piece has four sections, and I can practice for 25 minutes on each of five days. The second section is the hardest because I keep missing the rhythm; the last section is already reasonably comfortable. I would like to practice slowly with a metronome and leave a few minutes at the end of each session to play something enjoyable. Please suggest a flexible schedule rather than promising that I will master the piece in one week.
task: Suggest a flexible five-day piano practice schedule.
